Name: Home page loads
Objective: Verify home page loads with correct title

Name: Navigation visible on home
Objective: Verify nav and login/register links are visible
Expected Result: Nav visible; Login and Get Started/Register links visible

Name: Login page loads
Objective: Verify login page title and form fields
Expected Result: Title 'Log In — Recipes'; email, password, submit, forgot password visible

Name: Register page loads
Objective: Verify register page title and form fields
Expected Result: Title 'Create Account — Recipes'; name, email, password, confirmation, submit visible

Name: Dashboard after login
Objective: Verify dashboard or redirect after login
Expected Result: Dashboard loads or redirect to home; welcome/dashboard content visible

Name: Authenticated navigation links
Objective: Verify Ingredients/Dashboard links for logged-in user
Expected Result: Nav visible; at least one of Ingredients or Dashboard link visible

Name: Register and login flow (E2E)
Precondition: No existing user with test email
Step: Register, logout, go to login, enter credentials, submit
Expected Result: User registered; redirected; logged in; name visible

Name: Recipe search by ingredients
Step: Add ingredient; go to dashboard; select ingredient; Search Recipes
Expected Result: Redirect to /recipes; results page with recipe list

Name: Add recipe to favorites
Objective: Save recipe and add to favorites
Step: Open recipe; Save Recipe; Add to Favorites; go to /favorites
Expected Result: Recipe in favorites; My Favorites page shows recipe

Name: Home page guest view
Objective: Verify URL, title, heading for guest
Expected Result: URL /; title correct; heading contains Fastest Way to Find or Welcome back

Name: Dashboard title and content
Objective: Verify dashboard title and welcome content
Expected Result: Title 'Dashboard — Recipes'; welcome or dashboard content visible

Name: Recipe search API response time
Step: Trigger recipe search; measure response time

Name: Home page WCAG 2.1 AA (a11y)
Objective: No critical/serious axe violations on home
Step: Run axe (or equivalent) on home page

Name: Login form keyboard and labels
Objective: Keyboard navigation and labels on login
Step: Navigate login with keyboard; check labels

Name: Recipe search accessibility
Objective: Focus order, labels, landmarks on recipe search
Step: Run a11y checks on recipe search flow
